actions.name: Bolt Damage
actions.description: Single-target projectile damage payload shared across caster and device sources.

parameters.description: Damage channel delivered by the bolt.
Typed damage expression for the bolt payload.
Directional input or trajectory token for the bolt path.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. light_weak and holy_orb damage types added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Ball Damage
actions.description: Area-of-effect damage payload centered on a point, target, or source actor.

parameters.description: Damage channel delivered by the ball effect.
Typed damage expression for the area payload.
Blast radius in tiles.
Targeting mode for the ball center.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Heal HP
actions.description: Restores hit points to the resolved target set.

parameters.description: Typed healing expression.
Who receives the healing payload.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Cure Status
actions.description: Removes one or more timed statuses from the resolved target set.

parameters.description: Status identifiers removed by this payload.
Who receives the cure payload.
How thoroughly the status is removed. full sets the counter to zero; halve divides the counter by two.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. cure_mode added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Apply Timed Buff
actions.description: Applies a timed beneficial status to the resolved target set.

parameters.description: Timed status granted by the payload.
Duration expression for the granted timed status. Can be explicit (base + dice), or policy_default to use the status's default_duration.
Who receives the timed buff.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Apply Oppose Elements
actions.description: Applies timed elemental oppose coverage without flattening it into permanent resistance.

parameters.description: Element set granted as timed oppose state.
Duration expression for the oppose state. Can be explicit (base + dice) or policy_default.
Who receives the timed oppose payload.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1 with explicit separation from permanent resistance.

actions.name: Teleport Self
actions.description: Relocates the acting entity according to a self-teleport mode and distance envelope.

parameters.description: Maximum relocation distance. Zero means policy-defined or level-wide.
Semantic mode of self-relocation.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Light Area
actions.description: Applies lighting to an area or illumination pattern.

parameters.description: Lighting radius. Zero means full local effect semantics are policy-defined.
Lighting presentation or effect style.
When present, projects GF_LITE_WEAK damage at this amount to light-sensitive monsters in the illuminated area. Omit when no damage component applies.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. damage_light_sensitive and room light_style added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Detect Entities
actions.description: Reveals one or more categories of entities or map objects.

parameters.description: Entity or map-object categories to reveal.
Optional reveal radius. Zero means full local search semantics are policy-defined.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Map Area
actions.description: Reveals structural dungeon information across a local area or wider scope.

parameters.description: Mapping depth or reveal style.
Mapping radius when reveal_mode is area-scoped. Zero means level scope.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Identify Item
actions.description: Reveals item knowledge for one or more selected items.

parameters.description: Selection scope for the identification payload.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Enchant Equipment
actions.description: Applies a positive equipment enchantment profile to a selected item.

parameters.description: Declared enchantment profile applied to the selected equipment.
Item selection mode for the enchantment.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Sleep Control
actions.description: Applies sleep control to one or more hostile targets.

parameters.description: Targeting envelope for the control payload.
Relative power used by downstream validation and resolution.
Area radius when target_mode is area-like.
Restricts the sleep effect to entities matching this tag. Omit to affect all entities.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. entity_filter added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Modify Player Speed
actions.description: Applies a timed haste or slow effect to the player. Replaces ApplyTimedBuff(haste) and SlowControl(self) usages with explicit speed semantics and canonical duration expressions.

parameters.description: Direction of the speed modification applied to the player.
Duration expression for the speed modification. Use level_multiplier for level-scaled durations.
Always self — player speed modifications apply only to the acting player.

provenance.summary: Redesigned in V2 Parity Pass. Replaces the former potency-based contract. Canonical action for all player haste and slow effects (set_fast, set_slow in MAngband). Duration is explicit and level-scalable via level_multiplier.

actions.name: Dispel By Tag
actions.description: Damages or clears entities selected by a reusable tag-based filter.

parameters.description: Tag filter used to choose affected entities.
Typed dispel amount expression.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Drain Life
actions.description: Delivers direct life-draining damage through a directed offensive payload.

parameters.description: Typed life-drain amount expression.
Directional input or trajectory token for the drain path.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Earthquake
actions.description: Applies a terrain-disrupting area mutation centered on the actor, target, or selected point.

parameters.description: Affected radius in tiles.
How the earthquake center is chosen.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Beam Damage
actions.description: Directed linear damage payload with beam semantics.

parameters.description: Damage channel delivered by the beam.
Typed damage expression for the beam payload.
Directional input or trajectory token for the beam path.

Optional terrain side-effect applied to each grid cell along the beam path. illuminate_path is the GF_LITE_WEAK grid effect that permanently lights cells. Stone to mud is the GF_KILL_WALL grid effect that converts stone to mud. Omit when no terrain effect applies.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2. light_weak damage type and terrain_effect parameter added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Teleport Target
actions.description: Forcibly relocates one or more targets away from their current position.

parameters.description: Maximum relocation distance. Zero means policy-defined or level-wide.
Target envelope for forced relocation.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2.

actions.name: Recall Or Level Shift
actions.description: Schedules or forces an inter-level relocation outcome.

parameters.description: Inter-level relocation mode used by the payload.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2.

actions.name: Darken Area
actions.description: Applies darkness or visibility suppression to an area.

parameters.description: Affected darkness radius.
Darkness application style.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2.

actions.name: Recharge Item
actions.description: Restores device resource state according to a declared recharge power.

parameters.description: Relative recharge strength used by downstream resolution.
Device kinds the recharge payload is allowed to target.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2 with explicit policy separation for recharge risk.

actions.name: Brand Weapon
actions.description: Applies a declared brand profile to a selected weapon.

parameters.description: Brand applied to the target weapon.
Weapon selection mode.
Relative success chance for the brand application.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2.

actions.name: Alter Terrain
actions.description: Applies a reusable terrain or feature transformation payload.

parameters.description: Declared terrain or feature operation.
How the terrain transformation is aimed or centered.
Optional area radius for area-like terrain operations.
Optional entity-level side effect applied during terrain alteration. remove_all_in_radius covers the destroy_area(full=TRUE) monster-deletion behavior.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2. terrain_operation values trimmed to core set and formatted for parity.

actions.name: Confuse Control
actions.description: Applies confusion control to one or more targets.

parameters.description: Targeting envelope for the control payload.
Relative power used by downstream validation and resolution.
Optional duration expression when the payload applies timed confusion directly.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2.

actions.name: Fear Control
actions.description: Applies fear control to one or more targets.

parameters.description: Targeting envelope for the control payload.
Relative power used by downstream validation and resolution.
Area radius when target_mode is area-like.
Restricts the fear effect to entities matching this tag. Omit to affect all entities.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2. entity_filter added for selective fear targeting.

actions.name: Modify Resource Meter
actions.description: Adjusts a character resource meter such as food, sanity, or mana.

parameters.description: The resource meter to modify.
The modification operation on the meter.
Optional amount for replenish/drain modes.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for satisfying hunger and mana restoration. Added in MAngband Parity Pass.

actions.name: Remove Curse
actions.description: Removes curse status from a selected item or set of items.

parameters.description: How many items are affected by curse removal.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for removing item curses. Added in MAngband Parity Pass for prayer_remove_curse.

actions.name: Transform Entity
actions.description: Transforms or polymorph a targeted entity to another form or random type.

parameters.description: Type of transformation applied.
How the target entity is selected.
Optional specific target type when transform_rule is specific.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for polymorph effects. Added in MAngband Parity Pass for magic_polymorph_other.

actions.name: Inspect Entity
actions.description: Reveals detailed information about one or more entities.

parameters.description: What information to reveal about the entity.
How many entities are inspected.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for probing and entity inspection. Added in MAngband Parity Pass for prayer_probing.

actions.name: Clone Monster
actions.description: Creates a duplicate copy of the targeted monster adjacent to its current position. The clone is a separate entity with full HP.

parameters.description: Directional input or trajectory token used to select the target monster.

provenance.summary: MAngband: clone_monster() calls multiply_monster() on the targeted monster. Distinct from TransformEntity (which replaces) and SummonEntities (which creates independent entities). Added to resolve rod_of_clone_monster and TransformEntity workaround.

actions.name: Modify Monster Speed
actions.description: Applies a temporary speed modification (haste or slow) to one or more monsters.

parameters.description: Direction of the speed modification applied to the target(s).
Targeting envelope. Use aimed for single-target directed use; all_in_los for sweep effects.

provenance.summary: MAngband: speed_monster() (single aimed) and speed_monsters() (all in LOS). Distinct from SlowControl (which targets groups with potency). Added to resolve rod_of_haste_monster and staff_of_haste_monsters unresolved mappings.

actions.name: Aggravate Monsters
actions.description: Awakens all sleeping monsters within the aggravation radius and causes all monsters within line of sight to move at maximum speed.

parameters.description: Wake radius for sleeping monsters. Zero means level-wide.

provenance.summary: MAngband: aggravate_monsters() wakes sleeping monsters within 40 squares and hastes monsters in LOS. Added to resolve scroll_of_aggravate_monster unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Apply Item Curse
actions.description: Applies a destructive curse to the selected equipped item, removing special powers and applying a negative magical bonus.

parameters.description: Equipment slot containing the item to curse.
Numerator of the fractional chance (N in 2) that artifacts resist the curse. Default 1.

provenance.summary: MAngband: curse_armor() and curse_weapon() remove special powers and apply -2d5 magical penalty. Artifacts have 1-in-2 resistance. Added to resolve scroll_curse_armor and scroll_curse_weapon unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Create Traps
actions.description: Creates random traps on all empty floor squares within a given radius of the caster.

parameters.description: Radius within which empty floor squares receive traps.
Center point for trap placement.

provenance.summary: MAngband: trap_creation() places traps on all empty floor squares in a 1-radius ring around the player. Added to resolve scroll_of_trap_creation unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Apply Damage
actions.description: Applies direct HP damage to a resolved target set without projectile semantics. Covers self-inflicted damage (eating harmful consumables), thrown-item impact, environmental hazards, and melee damage that does not fit a more specific action.

parameters.description: Damage channel applied to the target.
Typed damage amount expression.
Who receives the damage. self covers eating/drinking harmful items; aimed covers thrown item impact.

provenance.summary: Added to resolve the consumable self-damage and thrown-damage gap identified in consumables.json. BoltDamage(direction=self) and BoltDamage(direction=thrown) were non-canonical workarounds. ApplyDamage has no projectile/beam semantics and covers the direct-application cases.
